inlines.v: TETRAG'ONAL, adjective Pertaining to a tetragon; having four angles or sides. Thus a square, a parallelogram, a rhombus, and a trapezium, are tetragonal figures. 1. In botany, having four prominent longitudinal angles, as a stem.
